panels.visual: Aristotle in fine clothes with rings on his fingers, thin legs, small eyes, lisping, a mirror in hand
panels.caption: Writers said Aristotle had thin legs and small eyes, a lisp, fine clothes and rings.

panels.visual: Aristotle cutting open a fish and a tiny octopus on a table, notebook and labelled sketches of hundreds of animals
panels.caption: He studied everything and described hundreds of animals.

panels.visual: A big pile of scrolls on stars, plants, poetry, politics and logic, with Aristotle perched at the top reading
panels.caption: Animals, plants, the stars, poetry, politics, how arguments work.

panels.visual: Aristotle writing in a book 'women have fewer teeth than men', his wife with a big smile showing a full set of teeth, comic
panels.caption: He thought women had fewer teeth than men. He never checked.
